title: 182. Decode String

examples.explanation: Repeat 'a' 3 times and 'bc' 2 times, concatenating to 'aaabcbc'.
Inner '2[c]' becomes 'cc', so 'a2[c]' is 'acc', repeated 3 times.

hints: Use two stacks: one for repeat counts and one for the string built so far.
On ']' pop the count and previous string, repeat the current segment, and append it to the previous string.
